verified: Tidal announced that it will ban fully AI-generated music on December 9 and says such tracks made up 43% of uploads over the previous 90 days and more than 60% of new uploads on November 6; it also says the ban covers only fully AI-generated music, not human-made tracks that use AI tools.
unconfirmed: The exact deletion figure is inconsistent across reports — 27 million in Ars Technica versus about 29 million in The Verge — and Tidal's estimates of 80,000 to 85,000 daily rejections and a 96% zero-play share, along with how it will detect fully AI-generated tracks, have not been independently verified.

verified: Tidal官方账号和音乐负责人Robert Andersen确认了12月9日生效的禁令及“仅限完全AI生成”的适用范围；Tidal还表示，被标注曲目中有96%在过去90天零播放。
unconfirmed: 删除规模与每日拒收量均为公司单方数据，且删除数字相互矛盾——《The Verge》引述Andersen称约2900万首，Ars Technica则报道当前标注为AI的曲目为2700万首、占目录6.3%；检测准确率和误判申诉机制也没有独立验证或说明。

titles.en: Tidal to ban fully AI-generated music on December 9
titles.zh: Tidal将于12月9日起封禁完全AI生成音乐
